ModMetaData.name: Venus Touch Waistlines - shirt tail prototype (test only)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Development only, never published. Replaces the vanilla button shirt for the Male body (south, east, north) with the vanilla to WDI transfer of 2026-11-05 (TailorMade's method, bands, C' shirt tail), to see it in game. The textures are computed from Ludeon's, so the folder stays out of the public repository.
